title: 分层建模检查器：DWS 不得直接读 ODS、ADS 不得反向写 DWD
code:
# 分层建模检查器：ODS / DWD / DWS / ADS 的依赖合法性
LAYER_RANK = {"ODS": 1, "DWD": 2, "DWS": 3, "ADS": 4}
LAYER_NAME = {1: "ODS原始数据层", 2: "DWD明细数据层", 3: "DWS汇总数据层", 4: "ADS应用数据层"}
MAX_READ_SPAN = 1   # 只允许读取「相邻下层」，跨度 >= 2 即跨层依赖

# (任务名, 产出层, 产出表, 读取的上游表)
TASKS_A = [
    ("sync_ods_order_log",     "ODS", "ods_order_log",     []),
    ("sync_ods_user_log",      "ODS", "ods_user_log",      []),
    ("build_dwd_order_detail", "DWD", "dwd_order_detail",  ["ods_order_log", "ods_user_log"]),
    ("build_dwd_user_info",    "DWD", "dwd_user_info",     ["ods_user_log"]),
    ("build_dws_trade_user",   "DWS", "dws_trade_user_1d", ["dwd_order_detail", "dwd_user_info"]),
    ("build_ads_gmv",          "ADS", "ads_gmv_overview",  ["dws_trade_user_1d"]),
]

TASKS_B = [
    ("sync_ods_order_log",     "ODS", "ods_order_log",     []),
    ("build_dwd_order_detail", "DWD", "dwd_order_detail",  ["ods_order_log"]),
    ("build_dws_trade_user",   "DWS", "dws_trade_user_1d", ["ods_order_log", "dwd_order_detail"]),
    ("repair_dwd_from_ads",    "ADS", "dwd_order_detail",  ["dws_trade_user_1d"]),
]

TABLE_LAYER = {
    "ods_order_log": "ODS", "ods_user_log": "ODS",
    "dwd_order_detail": "DWD", "dwd_user_info": "DWD",
    "dws_trade_user_1d": "DWS", "ads_gmv_overview": "ADS",
}


def check_layering(tasks):
    """返回违规列表，元素为 (违规类型, 说明)。"""
    bad = []
    for name, layer, target, reads in sorted(tasks):
        target_layer = TABLE_LAYER[target]
        if LAYER_RANK[layer] != LAYER_RANK[target_layer]:
            bad.append(("写入层不匹配", "task=" + name + " layer=" + layer +
                        " -> table=" + target + "(" + target_layer + ")"))
        for up in sorted(reads):
            span = LAYER_RANK[layer] - LAYER_RANK[TABLE_LAYER[up]]
            if span < 0:
                bad.append(("反向依赖", "task=" + name + "(" + layer + ") 读取了高层表 " +
                            up + "(" + TABLE_LAYER[up] + ") span=" + str(span)))
            elif span > MAX_READ_SPAN:
                bad.append(("跨层依赖", "task=" + name + "(" + layer + ") 直接读取 " +
                            up + "(" + TABLE_LAYER[up] + ") span=" + str(span)))
    return bad


def report(tag, tasks, expect_zero):
    bad = check_layering(tasks)
    print("== 用例 " + tag + "：" + ("合规分层链路（期望 0 条违规）" if expect_zero
                                  else "存在违规的链路（期望 >0 条违规）") + " ==")
    for name, layer, target, reads in tasks:
        ups = ", ".join(u + "(" + TABLE_LAYER[u] + ")" for u in sorted(reads)) or "无"
        print("  [" + layer + "] " + name + " -> " + target +
              "(" + TABLE_LAYER[target] + ")  读取: " + ups)
    print("  违规总数 = " + str(len(bad)))
    for kind, detail in bad:
        print("    - " + kind + ": " + detail)
    return bad


print("层位定义: " + ", ".join(v + "=" + str(LAYER_RANK[v]) for v in
                              sorted(LAYER_RANK, key=lambda x: LAYER_RANK[x])))
print("允许读取跨度（层位差）上限 = " + str(MAX_READ_SPAN))
print("")

bad_a = report("A", TASKS_A, True)
print("")
bad_b = report("B", TASKS_B, False)

kinds_a = sorted(set(k for k, _ in bad_a))
kinds_b = sorted(set(k for k, _ in bad_b))
print("")
print("用例 A 违规类型 = " + str(kinds_a))
print("用例 B 违规类型 = " + str(kinds_b))
print("判据 1（合规链路检出 0 条违规）: " + str(len(bad_a) == 0))
print("判据 2（检出 DWS 直接读 ODS 的跨层依赖）: " + str("跨层依赖" in kinds_b and len(bad_b) >= 1))
print("判据 3（检出 ADS 反向写 DWD）: " + str(any("写入层不匹配" in k and "ADS" in d and "DWD" in d
                                            for k, d in bad_b)))
expected_output:
层位定义: ODS=1, DWD=2, DWS=3, ADS=4
允许读取跨度（层位差）上限 = 1

== 用例 A：合规分层链路（期望 0 条违规） ==
  [ODS] sync_ods_order_log -> ods_order_log(ODS)  读取: 无
  [ODS] sync_ods_user_log -> ods_user_log(ODS)  读取: 无
  [DWD] build_dwd_order_detail -> dwd_order_detail(DWD)  读取: ods_order_log(ODS), ods_user_log(ODS)
  [DWD] build_dwd_user_info -> dwd_user_info(DWD)  读取: ods_user_log(ODS)
  [DWS] build_dws_trade_user -> dws_trade_user_1d(DWS)  读取: dwd_order_detail(DWD), dwd_user_info(DWD)
  [ADS] build_ads_gmv -> ads_gmv_overview(ADS)  读取: dws_trade_user_1d(DWS)
  违规总数 = 0

== 用例 B：存在违规的链路（期望 >0 条违规） ==
  [ODS] sync_ods_order_log -> ods_order_log(ODS)  读取: 无
  [DWD] build_dwd_order_detail -> dwd_order_detail(DWD)  读取: ods_order_log(ODS)
  [DWS] build_dws_trade_user -> dws_trade_user_1d(DWS)  读取: dwd_order_detail(DWD), ods_order_log(ODS)
  [ADS] repair_dwd_from_ads -> dwd_order_detail(DWD)  读取: dws_trade_user_1d(DWS)
  违规总数 = 2
    - 跨层依赖: task=build_dws_trade_user(DWS) 直接读取 ods_order_log(ODS) span=2
    - 写入层不匹配: task=repair_dwd_from_ads layer=ADS -> table=dwd_order_detail(DWD)

用例 A 违规类型 = []
用例 B 违规类型 = ['写入层不匹配', '跨层依赖']
判据 1（合规链路检出 0 条违规）: True
判据 2（检出 DWS 直接读 ODS 的跨层依赖）: True
判据 3（检出 ADS 反向写 DWD）: True
